card.summary: approx. 1 MB per paste, no account, no count limit. Measured: 1,000,000 bytes stored and retrievable; 2,400,000 bytes -> connection reset.

free_tier.stated: approx. 1 MB per paste, no account, no count limit. Measured: 1,000,000 bytes stored and retrievable; 2,400,000 bytes -> connection reset.

egress.terms: free direct GET over HTTPS, plain text, no metering.

record.tooling: plain TCP: `nc termbin.com 9999` returns the URL on the socket. Works with any netcat, and with bash /dev/tcp where nc is absent (used for the probes here).
record.chaining: Unlimited pastes x ~1 MB. Its distinguishing property is that it needs no HTTP client and no TLS. A raw TCP sink. Useful as an out-of-band manifest/credential store, useless as a bulk tier.
record.limits_note: ~1 MB per paste; no expiry documented; no delete path; no listing.
record.reliability_note: Oversized input exceeding the buffer threshold causes an immediate TCP connection reset, losing partial data without descriptive error messages. Slugs consist of random 4 to 5 character identifiers.

evidence.proved: 'echo just testing! | nc termbin.com 9999' -> 'https://termbin.com/test'; returns a URL on the socket
probe: 1,000,000-byte payload -> , GET bytes=1000000; 2,400,000-byte payload -> cat: write error: Connection reset by peer
